entries.question: Opd today band rahega
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD aur OT (Operation Theatre) sabhi Gazetted Holidays par band rehte hain. 

28 March 2026 ko koi Gazetted Holiday nahi hai, isliye OPD khuli honi chahiye. Haalaanki, OPD services ke liye online appointment book karna anivarya (mandatory) hai. 

Aap apna appointment yahan book kar sakte hain:
* **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
* **SMS:** "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.
* **Helpline:** 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karein.

Kripya dhyan dein ki mein ek AI assistant hoon, medical advice nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi health issue hai, toh kripya doctor se sampark karein aur apni personal medical details yahan share na karein.

entries.question: 28/03/26 ko dentale opd khula rahega
entries.answer:
28 March 2026 (Shanivar) ko Dental OPD khuli rahegi. KGMU mein OPD services Somvar se Shanivar tak chalti hain (Shanivar ko samay 9:00 AM se 12:00 PM tak hota hai).

**Dhyan dein:**
1. **Online Appointment:** OPD mein dikhane ke liye online registration/appointment anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar apna slot book kar sakte hain.
2. **Helpline:** Kisi bhi confusion ke liye aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call kar sakte hain.

Ek mahatvapurn baat: Main ek AI assistant hoon, isliye medical salah (diagnosis ya treatment) nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi dental samasya hai, toh kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein. Apni personal health details, phone number ya Aadhaar card jaisi jankari yahan chat mein share na karein, yeh aapki suraksha ke liye hai.

entries.question: Opd kal khulga
entries.answer:

Agar kal koi sarkari chhutti (Gazetted Holiday) nahi hai, toh OPD khuli rahegi. Aap kripya upar di gayi "KGMU Holiday Calendar 2026" ki list check kar lein ki kya kal koi chhutti toh nahi hai.

**Zaroori Jankari:**
* OPD mein dikhane ke liye **online registration anivarya (mandatory)** hai.
* Aap appointment [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par ya 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333 par call karke book kar sakte hain.
* Appointment booking ke liye aap 8887019134 par "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" likhkar SMS bhi bhej sakte hain.

*Disclaimer: Main medical salah nahi de sakta. Kripya kisi doctor se paramarsh lein aur apni vyaktigat jankari (jaise mobile number ya Aadhaar) yahan share na karein.*

entries.question: Aaj opd khulega ya nahi
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD ka samay is prakar hai:

*   **Somvar se Shukravar (Mon–Fri):** Subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak.
*   **Shanivar (Sat):** Subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 12:00 baje tak.
*   **Ravivar (Sunday):** OPD band rehti hai.

**Kripya dhyan dein:**
1. **Gazetted Holidays:** Sabhi sarkari chuttiyon (Gazetted Holidays) par OPD aur OT band rehte hain.
2. **Emergency:** Emergency sevaen (Emergency Services) 24/7 chalti hain.
3. **Appointment:** KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par ya helpline number **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333** par call karke appointment le sakte hain.

Agar aapko kisi bimari ke lakshan hain, toh kripya kisi doctor se KGMU OPD mein milen. Apni sehat se judi jankari, jaise ki symptoms ya personal data, yahan chat mein share na karein.

**Last Saturday** (ya mahine ka koi bhi Shanivar) hone par OPD band nahi hoti hai, jab tak ki us din koi **Gazetted (General) Holiday** na ho.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   **Gazetted Holidays:** Agar mahine ka aakhri Shanivar kisi sarkari chutti (General Holiday) ke din padta hai, tabhi OPD aur OT band rahenge.
*   **Emergency:** Emergency sevaen (Emergency Services) 24/7 chalu rehti hain, chahe koi bhi din ho ya chutti ho.
*   **Appointment:** OPD ke liye online appointment lene ki salah di jaati hai taaki aapko wait na karna pade. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par ya helpline number **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333** par call karke check kar sakte hain.

entries.question: Opd appointment bo
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) to book your appointment online.
*   **Phone:** Call the appointment helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
*   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text "**APPOINTMENT <NAME>**" to **8887019134**.

**Important Information:**
*   **Online registration is mandatory** for all patients.
*   Please ensure you bring a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS when you visit the hospital.
*   OPD hours are from **9:00 AM to 2:00 PM**.
*   If you are seeking medical advice, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD. Please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

If you have any further questions about specific departments, please let me know!

entries.question: Opd appointment price
entries.answer:
The OPD registration fee at KGMU is **Rs. 50/-**, and the registration is valid for 6 months.

Please note the following important information regarding OPD appointments:
*   **Online registration is mandatory** for all patients.
*   You can book your appointment through the official portal at **[www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)**.
*   Alternatively, you can call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
*   You can also book via SMS by sending "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to **8887019134**.

When visiting the hospital for your appointment, please ensure you carry a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS.

***

**Medical Disclaimer:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. If you are experiencing a medical emergency or need specific health advice, please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or visit the nearest emergency department. Also, for your safety, please avoid sharing sensitive personal details like Aadhaar numbers or private health records in this chat.

entries.question: Where to go to booking appointment offline
entries.answer:
As per the official KGMU guidelines, **online registration is mandatory** for all patients. There is no traditional "offline" window for booking appointments in advance. 

However, you can utilize the following methods to secure your appointment:

1.  **Online Portal:** Visit **[www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)** to book your slot.
2.  **Phone:** Call the dedicated helpline numbers at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
3.  **SMS Service:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT <YOUR NAME>" to **8887019134**.

**Important Note for your visit:**
*   You must arrive with a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS.
*   The OPD registration fee is **Rs. 50/-**, and the registration remains valid for 6 months.
*   OPD hours are from **9:00 AM to 2:00 PM** (except Sundays and specific gazetted holidays).

If you are a new patient, please ensure you have your details ready before using the online or phone booking services.

***

*Medical Disclaimer: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the official helpline for specific health concerns. Also, for your safety, please avoid sharing sensitive personal details like phone numbers or Aadhaar numbers in this chat.*

entries.question: Security officer  post examination details
entries.answer:
To assist you with information regarding the **Security Officer** post examination details, I recommend checking the official KGMU website, as all recruitment and examination notifications are published there.

Please follow these steps to find the information you need:

1.  **Visit the official website:** Go to [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org).
2.  **Check the "Recruitment" or "Notice" sections:** Look for the "Recruitment" tab or "Notice Board" on the homepage. All updates regarding written exams, admit cards, or result declarations for non-teaching posts are posted there.
3.  **Contact the Registrar's Office:** If you cannot find the specific information online, you can contact the **Registrar's Office** for official inquiries regarding recruitment:
    *   **Phone:** 0522-2253171
4.  **IP Phone Directory:** You can also look for the specific department or the administrative wing in the **[KGMU IP Phone Directory](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php)** to reach out to the relevant HR or Recruitment cell.

**Note:** I do not have access to real-time internal recruitment databases. Please ensure you only check the official [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) portal to avoid misinformation. 

*Reminder: Please do not share your personal details, Aadhaar number, or application ID in this chat for your safety.*
